description.zh: 贝拉特是阿尔巴尼亚最美丽的历史城市之一，被称为「千窗之城」。奥斯曼时期的白色石灰岩房屋密密麻麻地覆盖在山坡上，窗户层叠倒映着山谷与河流，2008年列入UNESCO世界遗产名录。
description.en: Berat is one of Albania's most beautiful historic cities, nicknamed the 'City of a Thousand Windows'. Ottoman-era white limestone houses blanket the hillside, their layered windows reflected in the valley and river. A UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2008.

location.zh: 贝拉特省，阿尔巴尼亚中南部

description.zh: 吉诺卡斯特是阿尔巴尼亚南部的「石头城」，依山而建的灰色石板屋顶民居与高耸的城堡构成壮观的中世纪城市景观。同样是UNESCO世界遗产，被誉为「文明的十字路口」。
description.en: Gjirokaster is Albania's southern 'Stone City', with grey slate-roofed houses cascading up the hillside beneath a towering castle — a spectacular medieval cityscape and fellow UNESCO World Heritage Site.

location.zh: 吉诺卡斯特省，阿尔巴尼亚南部

description.zh: 布特林特是阿尔巴尼亚最重要的考古遗址，拥有希腊、罗马、拜占庭和威尼斯各时期叠加的文明层次。遗址位于泻湖之畔，风景如画，1992年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Butrint is Albania's most important archaeological site, with layers of Greek, Roman, Byzantine and Venetian civilization. Beautifully set beside a lagoon, it has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1992.

location.zh: 萨兰达附近，阿尔巴尼亚南部

description.zh: 绵延100余公里的地中海海岸线，拥有清澈湛蓝的海水、金色沙滩和错落有致的渔村。希马尔、德尔米等海湾尚未被商业化开发，被誉为地中海最后的秘境之一。
description.en: Over 100 km of Mediterranean coastline with crystal-clear turquoise water, golden beaches and charming fishing villages. Bays like Himara and Dhermi remain refreshingly uncommercialised — one of the Mediterranean's last hidden gems.

location.zh: 弗洛勒省，阿尔巴尼亚西南海岸

description.zh: 斯蒂思是阿尔巴尼亚阿尔卑斯山中的世外桃源，四面被海拔超过2000米的山峰环绕。这里有传统的「荣誉的塔楼」（Kulla）、瀑布和徒步路线，是巴尔干最壮观的山地景观之一。
description.en: Theth is a remote Shangri-La in the Albanian Alps, ringed by peaks over 2,000 m. Traditional honour towers (Kulla), waterfalls and hiking trails make it one of the Balkans' most spectacular mountain destinations.

description.zh: 蓝眼泉（Syri i Kaltër）是阿尔巴尼亚最神奇的自然奇观之一。泉水从深达50米的地下涌出，颜色由中心深蓝向外渐变为碧绿，水温常年保持在10°C左右，晶莹剔透，令人叹为观止。
description.en: Blue Eye Spring (Syri i Kaltrer) is one of Albania's most magical natural wonders. Water wells up from over 50 m underground, graduating from deep blue at the centre to emerald green, with a constant temperature of around 10°C.

location.zh: 萨兰达附近，阿尔巴尼亚南部

description.zh: 阿波罗尼亚是公元前6世纪希腊人建立的古城遗址，曾是古代地中海最重要的城市之一。凯撒曾在此读书，奥古斯都也在此度过青年时光。遗址保存有剧场、柱廊和博物馆。
description.en: Apollonia was founded by Greeks in the 6th century BC and became one of antiquity's most important cities. Julius Caesar studied here; Augustus spent his youth here. The site preserves a theatre, colonnades and a fine museum.

location.zh: 弗洛勒省，阿尔巴尼亚西部

description.zh: 克萨米尔是阿尔巴尼亚里维埃拉最南端的度假小镇，拥有多处白沙滩和近海小岛。海水能见度极高，适合浮潜和游泳，毗邻布特林特国家公园，自然与历史兼备。
description.en: Ksamil is the southernmost resort town of the Albanian Riviera, with several white-sand beaches and offshore islets. Crystal-clear water makes it ideal for snorkelling; it sits adjacent to Butrint National Park.

location.zh: 萨兰达市附近，阿尔巴尼亚最南端

description.zh: 长城是中国最具代表性的历史建筑，绵延超过21,000公里。建于多个朝代，主要段落修建于明代。慕田峪和司马台等段落保存完好，可俯瞰壮观的山地景色。
description.en: The Great Wall stretches over 21,000 km and is China's most iconic monument. Built across dynasties, the best-preserved Ming-era sections at Mutianyu and Simatai offer stunning mountain panoramas.

description.zh: 故宫是世界上保存最完整的古代皇宫建筑群，占地72万平方米，拥有近万间房屋。自1420年起作为明清两代皇宫使用长达近600年，现为故宫博物院。
description.en: The Forbidden City is the world's largest and best-preserved imperial palace complex, covering 72 ha with nearly 10,000 rooms. It served as the Ming and Qing imperial palace for nearly 600 years from 1420.

description.zh: 杭州西湖是中国最著名的淡水湖之一，湖光山色与历史人文交相辉映。苏堤、白堤将湖面分割成数个区域，四季风景各异，是文人墨客吟咏千年的胜地。
description.en: West Lake in Hangzhou is one of China's most celebrated freshwater lakes. The Su and Bai Causeways divide its shimmering surface, creating distinct zones of beauty that have inspired poets for a thousand years.

description.zh: 九寨沟是四川省北部的仙境般的峡谷国家公园，以翡翠色的多层瀑布、色彩斑斓的湖泊和雪山为特色。水中倒映着五颜六色的林木，被誉为「童话世界」。
description.en: Jiuzhaigou is a fairy-tale canyon national park in northern Sichuan, famous for its multi-tiered turquoise waterfalls, kaleidoscopic lakes and snow-capped peaks reflected in crystal-clear water.

description.zh: 云南哈尼族人历经1300余年开凿的元阳梯田，随山势蜿蜒起伏，层层叠叠多达3000余层。日出时分，薄雾中的金色水面与天空融为一体，呈现出令人窒息的壮观景象。
description.en: Carved over 1,300 years by the Hani people, Yuanyang's terraces cascade down the mountains in over 3,000 tiers. At sunrise, the mist-shrouded golden water merges with the sky in a breathtaking tableau.

description.zh: 张家界国家森林公园以成千上万座石英砂岩柱峰著称，这些奇特地貌据称是电影《阿凡达》中悬浮山脉的灵感来源。玻璃栈道和缆车让游客得以近距离欣赏这片超现实景观。
description.en: Zhangjiajie is famous for thousands of quartz-sandstone pillar peaks, said to inspire the floating mountains in Avatar. Glass walkways and cable cars let visitors experience this surreal landscape up close.

description.zh: 富士山是日本最高峰，海拔3,776米，完美的锥形火山轮廓是日本的象征。每年7至8月开放登山，周边的富士五湖提供经典倒影美景。
description.en: At 3,776 m, Mount Fuji is Japan's highest peak. Its perfect conical silhouette is the nation's symbol. Open for climbing July-August; the Fuji Five Lakes provide iconic mirror reflections.

description.zh: 京都拥有超过1600座寺庙和400座神社，其中金阁寺、清水寺、岚山竹林等最为著名。每年春季赏樱和秋季赏枫时节，吸引数以百万计的游客。
description.en: Kyoto has over 1,600 temples and 400 shrines. Kinkaku-ji, Kiyomizu-dera and Arashiyama Bamboo Grove are among the most visited. Cherry blossom and autumn foliage seasons draw millions.

description.zh: 涩谷十字路口是全球最繁忙的十字路口之一，每次绿灯约有3,000人同时穿行。周边聚集了东京最前沿的时尚、美食和娱乐，是现代都市文化的缩影。
description.en: Shibuya Crossing is one of the world's busiest intersections — some 3,000 people cross at once on each green light. The surrounding district is Tokyo's epicentre of fashion, food and urban pop culture.

description.zh: 广岛和平纪念公园见证了二战的历史教训；乘船15分钟可达的宫岛岛上，严岛神社的朱红大鸟居矗立于海中，是日本三景之一。
description.en: Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park bears witness to the lessons of WWII. A 15-minute ferry brings you to Miyajima island, where Itsukushima Shrine's vermilion torii gate rises from the sea — one of Japan's Three Views.

location.zh: 广岛县广岛市及廿日市市

description.zh: 大阪城是日本最著名的城堡之一，16世纪由丰臣秀吉主持修建。高达58米的天守阁俯瞰大片樱花园，内部设有展示日本统一历史的博物馆。
description.en: Osaka Castle is one of Japan's most famous castles, built by Toyotomi Hideyoshi in the 16th century. The 58 m keep overlooks extensive cherry-blossom gardens and houses a museum on Japan's unification.

description.zh: 泰姬陵是莫卧儿皇帝沙贾汗为悼念爱妻慕塔芝·玛哈尔而建的白色大理石陵墓，1632年始建，被誉为世界七大奇迹之一和「永恒的爱情象征」。
description.en: The Taj Mahal is a white marble mausoleum built by Mughal emperor Shah Jahan for his beloved wife Mumtaz Mahal from 1632. One of the Seven Wonders of the World and an eternal symbol of love.

description.zh: 瓦拉纳西是印度最神圣的城市，也是世界上最古老的持续有人居住的城市之一。每天清晨，成千上万的印度教信徒在恒河河坛（Ghat）边沐浴祈祷，场景庄严神圣。
description.en: Varanasi is India's holiest city and one of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities. Each dawn, thousands of Hindu pilgrims bathe and pray on the river ghats in scenes of profound spiritual intensity.

description.zh: 喀拉拉邦的水乡是由900余公里的河流、湖泊和运河构成的网络。乘坐传统的茅草船屋（Kettuvallam）在棕榈树成荫的水道中漂流，体验南印度独特的水上生活方式。
description.en: Kerala's backwaters are a network of 900+ km of rivers, lakes and canals. Drifting through palm-shaded waterways in a traditional thatched houseboat (Kettuvallam) is an iconic South Indian experience.

description.zh: 斋浦尔是拉贾斯坦邦首府，因城中众多建筑采用玫瑰粉色砂岩建造而得名「粉红之城」。琥珀堡、风之宫殿等景点集中体现了莫卧儿与拉杰普特风格融合的建筑艺术。
description.en: Jaipur is Rajasthan's capital — the 'Pink City' named for its rose-coloured sandstone buildings. Amber Fort and Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds) showcase the fusion of Mughal and Rajput architectural art.

description.zh: 果阿拥有印度最美丽的海滩，北果阿的派纳吉和卡兰古特海滩热闹繁华，南果阿的帕洛莱姆则宁静祥和。葡萄牙殖民时期留下的巴洛克教堂与热带海滩融为一体。
description.en: Goa has India's finest beaches. North Goa's Panaji and Calangute buzz with energy; South Goa's Palolem is serenely beautiful. Portuguese Baroque churches blend with tropical coastline.

description.zh: 埃菲尔铁塔于1889年为世界博览会而建，高324米，是巴黎最具代表性的地标。每晚整点灯光秀令人叹为观止，登顶可俯瞰塞纳河两岸的完整城市景观。
description.en: Built for the 1889 World's Fair, the 324 m Eiffel Tower is Paris's defining landmark. Its nightly light show is spectacular; the summit offers sweeping views along the Seine.

description.zh: 卢浮宫是世界上参观人数最多的艺术博物馆，收藏超过38万件藏品，包括《蒙娜丽莎》《断臂维纳斯》等旷世名作。宫殿本身始建于12世纪，建筑价值极高。
description.en: The Louvre is the world's most visited art museum, with over 380,000 works including the Mona Lisa and Venus de Milo. The palace itself dates to the 12th century and is architecturally magnificent.

description.zh: 圣米歇尔山是矗立于潮汐海湾中的岩石孤岛，岛上建有始于8世纪的修道院。涨潮时四面环海，退潮时可步行而至，是法国最具辨识度的景观之一。
description.en: Mont-Saint-Michel is a tidal island crowned by a monastery dating to the 8th century. Surrounded by sea at high tide and walkable at low tide, it is one of France's most recognisable landmarks.

location.zh: 诺曼底海岸，法国西北部

description.zh: 卢瓦尔河谷是法国最大的世界遗产区之一，沿河分布着逾300座中世纪城堡和庄园。香博尔城堡、舍农索城堡等见证了法国文艺复兴时期的黄金岁月。
description.en: The Loire Valley is home to over 300 medieval castles and manor houses. Chambord and Chenonceau exemplify the French Renaissance at its golden peak. A UNESCO World Heritage landscape.

description.zh: 每年6至7月，普罗旺斯高原的薰衣草田进入盛放期，连绵的紫色花海配上石砌村庄和蔚蓝天空，构成法国南部最标志性的田园风景。
description.en: Each June-July, Provence's plateau blazes purple with lavender in bloom. Rolling violet fields set against stone villages and cobalt skies form the quintessential image of southern France.

location.zh: 普罗旺斯地区，法国东南部

description.zh: 斗兽场建于公元70至80年，是古罗马帝国的象征，可同时容纳5万至8万名观众。尽管历经地震与掠夺，这座椭圆形竞技场至今仍是世界上最完好的古罗马建筑之一。
description.en: Built in 70-80 AD, the Colosseum is the symbol of the Roman Empire, once holding 50,000-80,000 spectators. Despite earthquakes and plunder, this elliptical amphitheatre remains the best-preserved of antiquity.

description.zh: 威尼斯建于118座小岛之上，由400余座桥梁相连，以运河代替街道。贡多拉游览、里阿托桥、圣马可广场和总督宫是这座浪漫水城的精华所在。
description.en: Venice is built on 118 islands linked by 400+ bridges, with canals serving as streets. Gondola rides, the Rialto Bridge, Piazza San Marco and the Doge's Palace are the highlights of this uniquely romantic city.

location.zh: 意大利威尼托大区威尼斯

description.zh: 阿马尔菲海岸是意大利南部那不勒斯湾的悬崖海岸线，彩色渔村层叠于峭壁之上，俯瞰湛蓝地中海。波西塔诺、阿马尔菲和拉韦罗等小镇是这条海岸线上的明珠。
description.en: The Amalfi Coast is a dramatic cliff-lined stretch south of Naples, with colourful fishing villages perched above turquoise Mediterranean waters. Positano, Amalfi town and Ravello are its jewels.

location.zh: 坎帕尼亚大区，意大利南部

description.zh: 托斯卡纳是意大利文艺复兴的发源地，以绵延起伏的山丘、柏树林荫大道、古老庄园和葡萄酒庄著称。佛罗伦萨、锡耶纳和圣吉米尼亚诺是其文化核心。
description.en: Tuscany is the cradle of the Italian Renaissance. Its rolling hills, cypress-lined roads, ancient estates and wine estates are legendary. Florence, Siena and San Gimignano are its cultural heart.

location.zh: 托斯卡纳大区，意大利中部

description.zh: 五渔村是利古里亚海岸峭壁上的五座彩色渔村——蒙泰罗索、韦尔纳扎、科尔尼利亚、马纳罗拉和里奥马焦雷，村庄间有徒步小径相连，风景如画。
description.en: Cinque Terre comprises five cliff-hugging fishing villages on the Ligurian coast — Monterosso, Vernazza, Corniglia, Manarola and Riomaggiore — linked by scenic hiking trails above the sea.

location.zh: 利古里亚大区，意大利西北部

description.zh: 雅典卫城矗立于市中心岩石高台之上，帕特农神庙是其核心建筑，建于公元前5世纪，是古希腊建筑艺术的巅峰之作，也是西方文明最重要的象征之一。
description.en: The Acropolis crowns Athens on a rocky plateau. Its centrepiece, the Parthenon (5th century BC), is the pinnacle of ancient Greek architecture and one of the defining symbols of Western civilisation.

description.zh: 圣托里尼岛是爱琴海上由火山喷发形成的弧形岛屿，白墙蓝顶的民居散布于火山口边缘的悬崖之上。伊亚村的日落被誉为世界最美夕阳之一。
description.en: Santorini is a crescent-shaped volcanic island in the Aegean. White-domed houses cling to the caldera rim, and the sunset at Oia village is considered one of the most beautiful in the world.

description.zh: 迈泰奥拉是矗立于色萨利平原巨大岩石柱上的东正教修道院群，14世纪僧侣用绳索和篮筐爬上这些岩石建造了修道院，如今是世界上最壮观的宗教圣地之一。
description.en: Meteora consists of Eastern Orthodox monasteries perched atop colossal rock pillars in Thessaly. 14th-century monks climbed by ropes and baskets to build them — today among the world's most spectacular sacred sites.

description.zh: 克里特岛是希腊最大的岛屿，也是古代米诺斯文明的发源地。克诺索斯宫殿遗址、萨马里亚峡谷、白山山脉和欧洲最古老的橄榄树，让这座岛屿兼具历史与自然魅力。
description.en: Crete is Greece's largest island and birthplace of Minoan civilisation. The Palace of Knossos, Samaria Gorge, White Mountains and Europe's oldest olive tree give it unmatched historical and natural depth.

description.zh: 自由女神像是法国赠予美国的礼物，建于1886年，是自由与民主的全球象征。她高46米，矗立于纽约港的自由岛上，手持火炬迎接来自世界各地的移民。
description.en: A gift from France in 1886, the 46 m Statue of Liberty is a global symbol of freedom and democracy. She stands on Liberty Island in New York Harbour, welcoming immigrants from around the world.

description.zh: 时代广场是纽约市最具活力的地标，每年有约5,000万游客到访。林立的LED广告牌、百老汇剧院、以及新年倒计时降球活动使其成为世界最著名的十字路口。
description.en: Times Square attracts 50 million visitors annually. Towering LED billboards, Broadway theatres and the iconic New Year's Eve ball drop make it the world's most famous crossroads.

description.zh: 金门大桥是旧金山的标志性建筑，1937年建成时是世界上最长的悬索桥，主跨达1,280米。橙红色的桥身横跨金门海峡，在旧金山的晨雾中若隐若现。
description.en: The Golden Gate Bridge was the world's longest suspension bridge at its 1937 completion, spanning 1,280 m. Its International Orange colour glows against the Bay Area fog and is San Francisco's defining image.

description.zh: 黄石是美国第一个国家公园（1872年），也是世界上最大的地热区，拥有间歇泉、热泥浆池、棱彩温泉等1万余个地热地貌，以及野牛、灰熊等野生动物。
description.en: Yellowstone (1872) is America's first national park and the world's largest geothermal area, with 10,000+ thermal features including geysers, hot springs and the Grand Prismatic Spring, plus bison and grizzly bears.

location.zh: 怀俄明州/蒙大拿州/爱达荷州

description.zh: 大峡谷是科罗拉多河历经数百万年侵蚀形成的壮观峡谷，长达446公里，最深处达1,857米。层层叠叠的彩色岩层记录了近20亿年的地球历史。
description.en: The Grand Canyon is a spectacular gorge carved by the Colorado River over millions of years, 446 km long and up to 1,857 m deep. Its layered colourful rock records nearly 2 billion years of Earth's history.

description.zh: 夏威夷火山国家公园包含两座活跃火山——基拉韦厄和冒纳罗亚，是世界上地质活动最活跃的地区之一。熔岩流入海洋的壮观景象和多样的生态系统吸引着来自全球的游客。
description.en: Hawaii Volcanoes NP contains two of the world's most active volcanoes — Kilauea and Mauna Loa. The sight of lava flowing into the ocean and the park's diverse ecosystems draw visitors from around the globe.

description.zh: 迈阿密南海滩（South Beach）以洁白的沙滩、装饰艺术风格建筑和充满活力的夜生活著称。碧绿的大西洋海水、多彩的人文氛围和永恒的阳光让其成为全美最受欢迎的度假目的地之一。
description.en: Miami's South Beach is known for white sands, Art Deco architecture and vibrant nightlife. Turquoise Atlantic water, a multicultural scene and year-round sunshine make it one of America's top resort destinations.

location.zh: 佛罗里达州迈阿密滩市

description.zh: 尼亚加拉瀑布由马蹄瀑布、美洲瀑布和新娘面纱瀑布三部分组成，是世界上流量最大的瀑布群之一。每秒约有168,000立方米的水从悬崖飞流而下，气势磅礴。
description.en: Niagara Falls comprises three waterfalls — Horseshoe, American and Bridal Veil. Together they form one of the world's highest-flow waterfalls, with some 168,000 m3 of water plunging every second.

description.zh: 班夫是加拿大第一个国家公园（1885年），位于落基山脉之中，以碧蓝的冰川湖（路易斯湖、梦莲湖）、雄伟的山峰和丰富的野生动物著称，是自然摄影师的天堂。
description.en: Banff is Canada's first national park (1885), set in the Rockies. Its glacier-fed turquoise lakes (Lake Louise, Moraine Lake), towering peaks and abundant wildlife make it a paradise for nature photographers.

description.zh: 魁北克城是北美保存最完好的城墙城市，旧城区的石砌街道、法式城堡酒店和北美唯一保存完整的城墙令人仿佛置身于法国中世纪古城。1985年列入UNESCO世界遗产。
description.en: Quebec City has North America's best-preserved fortified old town, with cobblestone streets, the Fairmont Chateau Frontenac and the only intact city walls in North America. A UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1985.

description.zh: 奇琴伊察是玛雅文明最重要的遗址之一，库库尔坎神庙（羽蛇神金字塔）在春秋分时节会出现蛇形阴影奇观。2007年评选为世界新七大奇迹之一。
description.en: Chichen Itza is one of the Maya's most important sites. At the spring and autumn equinoxes, the El Castillo pyramid creates a serpent-shadow effect. Voted one of the New Seven Wonders of the World in 2007.

description.zh: 坎昆是墨西哥最受欢迎的度假目的地，拥有24公里长的白沙滩和加勒比海清澈的碧蓝海水。酒店区（Zona Hotelera）汇集了众多豪华度假村，附近还有世界第二大珊瑚礁系统可供潜水。
description.en: Cancun is Mexico's most popular resort, with 24 km of white-sand beach and clear Caribbean water. The Hotel Zone is lined with luxury resorts; nearby lies the world's second-largest coral reef system for diving.

location.zh: 金塔纳罗奥州，墨西哥东南部

description.zh: 墨西哥城历史中心建于阿兹特克帝国首都特诺奇提特兰的遗址之上，宪法广场（索卡洛广场）是拉丁美洲最大的广场，周围有宏伟的主教座堂和国家宫，壁画艺术大师迭戈·里维拉的作品遍布其中。
description.en: Built on the ruins of Aztec Tenochtitlan, Mexico City's historic centre centres on the Zocalo, Latin America's largest plaza, flanked by a magnificent cathedral and National Palace adorned with Diego Rivera murals.

description.zh: 救世基督像矗立于里约热内卢科科瓦多山顶，高38米（含底座），双臂展开28米，俯瞰整个城市和瓜纳巴拉湾。1931年落成，是世界新七大奇迹之一。
description.en: Christ the Redeemer stands 38 m tall (including base) atop Corcovado mountain, arms outstretched 28 m, gazing over Rio and Guanabara Bay. Completed in 1931 and one of the New Seven Wonders of the World.

location.zh: 里约热内卢科科瓦多山

description.zh: 亚马逊是世界上最大的热带雨林，覆盖面积超过550万平方公里，是地球上超过10%物种的家园。从玛瑙斯出发可进行深度雨林探险，体验原始的热带生态系统。
description.en: The Amazon is the world's largest tropical rainforest, covering over 5.5 million km2 and home to more than 10% of all Earth's species. Manaus is the gateway for deep-jungle expeditions.

description.zh: 伊瓜苏瀑布横跨巴西和阿根廷边境，是世界上最宽的瀑布群，由275条瀑布组成，宽约2,700米。巴西侧可欣赏到全景，阿根廷侧则可近距离感受「魔鬼咽喉」的震撼。
description.en: Iguazu Falls straddles the Brazil-Argentina border — the world's widest waterfall system, with 275 falls stretching 2,700 m. Brazil's side gives the panoramic view; Argentina's side puts you inside the Devil's Throat.

description.zh: 里约狂欢节是全球最盛大的狂欢节，每年吸引超过200万人参与街头庆典。桑巴舞校在桑巴大道的巡游是其核心活动，华丽的服装、激昂的音乐和热情的舞蹈令全世界为之倾倒。
description.en: Rio Carnival is the world's largest, drawing over 2 million street revellers. The centrepiece is the samba school parade on the Sambadrome, a riot of elaborate costumes, thunderous drums and passionate dance.

description.zh: 马丘比丘是印加帝国最著名的遗址，建于公元15世纪，位于海拔2,430米的安第斯山脊之上，四周云雾缭绕。1983年列入UNESCO世界遗产，被誉为「失落的印加城市」。
description.en: Machu Picchu is the Inca Empire's most celebrated site, built in the 15th century on a 2,430 m Andean ridge shrouded in cloud. A UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1983 — the original 'Lost City of the Incas'.

description.zh: 的的喀喀湖是世界上海拔最高的可通航湖泊，海拔3,812米，跨越秘鲁与玻利维亚边境。湖中的芦苇岛（乌鲁斯浮岛）是当地印第安人世代居住的独特水上社区。
description.en: Lake Titicaca at 3,812 m is the world's highest navigable lake, straddling the Peru-Bolivia border. The floating reed islands (Uros) are unique water communities inhabited for generations.

description.zh: 纳斯卡线条是公元1世纪至700年间绘制于纳斯卡沙漠地表的巨型地画，图案包括猴子、蜂鸟、蜘蛛等动物形象，只有从空中才能完整看清，其目的至今仍是未解之谜。
description.en: The Nazca Lines are enormous geoglyphs etched into the desert between 1 AD and 700 AD — monkeys, hummingbirds, spiders — only fully visible from the air. Their purpose remains one of archaeology's great mysteries.

description.zh: 秘鲁亚马逊盆地覆盖全国60%的面积，是生物多样性极其丰富的热带雨林地区。马努国家公园被认为是世界上生物多样性最高的保护区之一，生活着超过1,000种鸟类。
description.en: Peru's Amazon Basin covers 60% of the country and is one of Earth's most biodiverse regions. Manu National Park is considered the world's most biodiverse protected area, home to over 1,000 bird species.

description.zh: 阿根廷侧的伊瓜苏瀑布可让游客近距离感受「魔鬼咽喉」——一条宽150米、落差达80米的U形峡谷瀑布，水雾腾空而起，震耳欲聋，被罗斯福夫人誉为「可怜的尼亚加拉」。
description.en: Argentina's side puts visitors inches from the Devil's Throat — a 150 m-wide, 80 m-drop U-shaped cataract whose mist and roar prompted Eleanor Roosevelt to exclaim 'Poor Niagara!'

location.zh: 米西奥内斯省，阿根廷东北部

description.zh: 巴塔哥尼亚是地球上最壮观的荒野之一，托雷斯德尔巴伊内国家公园的花岗岩三塔（Torres del Paine）是最具代表性的景观，狂风、冰川、湖泊和野生动物构成了极致的自然体验。
description.en: Patagonia is one of Earth's most spectacular wildernesses. Torres del Paine National Park's granite Torres peaks are its signature image, amid gale-force winds, glaciers, lakes and extraordinary wildlife.

location.zh: 圣克鲁斯省，阿根廷南部

description.zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯是阿根廷首都，被誉为「南美洲的巴黎」，以探戈舞蹈、欧式建筑、热情的夜生活和高质量的牛排著称。博卡区（La Boca）五彩斑斓的铁皮建筑是其最具辨识度的标志。
description.en: Buenos Aires — the 'Paris of South America' — is famous for tango, European-style architecture, passionate nightlife and world-class steak. La Boca's colourful corrugated-iron buildings are its most recognisable image.

location.zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯市，阿根廷东部

description.zh: 吉萨金字塔群由三座大金字塔和斯芬克斯狮身人面像组成，建于约公元前2560年。大金字塔（胡夫金字塔）高146.5米，是古代世界七大奇迹中唯一保存至今的建筑，也是世界上最古老的世界遗产之一。
description.en: The Giza Pyramid complex, built around 2560 BC, comprises three great pyramids and the Great Sphinx. The Great Pyramid of Khufu (146.5 m) is the only surviving Wonder of the Ancient World and one of humanity's oldest UNESCO sites.

description.zh: 卢克索古称「底比斯」，是古埃及最重要的宗教中心。卢克索神庙和卡纳克神庙组成世界上最大的神庙建筑群，「帝王谷」中安息着图坦卡蒙等众多法老。
description.en: Ancient Luxor was Thebes, Egypt's greatest religious capital. Luxor and Karnak temples form the world's largest temple complex; the Valley of the Kings holds Tutankhamun and dozens of other pharaohs.

description.zh: 乘坐传统费卢卡帆船或豪华游轮沿尼罗河航行，是欣赏埃及沿岸古迹的最佳方式。从卢克索到阿斯旺的经典航线沿途经过众多古庙和农村景色，是每位埃及旅者不可错过的体验。
description.en: Sailing the Nile on a traditional felucca or luxury cruise ship is the finest way to take in Egypt's riverside antiquities. The classic Luxor-to-Aswan route passes ancient temples and timeless rural landscapes.

description.zh: 阿布辛贝神庙是拉美西斯二世于公元前13世纪建造的岩凿神庙，四座高达20米的拉美西斯巨像守护着神庙入口。1968年整体迁移以避水库淹没，是人类文化遗产保护史上的奇迹。
description.en: Abu Simbel was carved from rock by Ramesses II in the 13th century BC, guarded by four 20 m colossi. Its 1968 relocation to avoid Lake Nasser is one of the greatest feats in heritage conservation history.

description.zh: 开罗埃及博物馆（现与大埃及博物馆GEM共存）收藏了超过16万件古埃及文物，其中包括图坦卡蒙的黄金面具和木乃伊展厅。是全球最重要的古埃及文物收藏地。
description.en: Cairo's Egyptian Museum houses over 160,000 ancient artefacts including Tutankhamun's golden mask and the Royal Mummies Hall. It is the world's pre-eminent collection of ancient Egyptian antiquities.

description.zh: 马赛马拉是肯尼亚最著名的野生动物保护区，与坦桑尼亚的塞伦盖蒂共同构成非洲最大的生态系统。每年7至10月的角马大迁徙被誉为「世界第八大奇迹」，数百万动物横渡马拉河的壮观景象令人终身难忘。
description.en: Maasai Mara is Kenya's most celebrated reserve, sharing an ecosystem with Tanzania's Serengeti. The July-October Great Migration — millions of wildebeest crossing the Mara River — is called the Eighth Wonder of the World.

location.zh: 纳罗克县，肯尼亚西南部

description.zh: 安博塞利国家公园以乞力马扎罗雪山为背景，是拍摄非洲象群最理想的地点之一。公园内生活着约1,600头大象，在白雪皑皑的非洲第一高峰映衬下，象群漫步的画面令人动容。
description.en: Amboseli frames Africa's largest elephant herds against the snows of Kilimanjaro, making it one of the continent's finest photography destinations. Around 1,600 elephants roam beneath Africa's highest peak.

description.zh: 迪亚尼海滩是肯尼亚印度洋海岸最美丽的海滩，拥有洁白的沙滩、温暖的热带海水和丰富的珊瑚礁，被多次评选为非洲最佳海滩。是结合野生动物狩猎与海滨度假的理想目的地。
description.en: Diani Beach is Kenya's finest Indian Ocean beach — white sands, warm water and rich coral reefs have earned it multiple Best Beach in Africa titles. An ideal end to a safari itinerary.

description.zh: 内罗毕国家公园是全球唯一位于首都城区内的野生动物保护区，可在城市摩天大楼的背景下近距离观察狮子、长颈鹿、犀牛等非洲野生动物，被称为「世界奇观」。
description.en: Nairobi National Park is the world's only wildlife reserve within a capital city. Lions, giraffes and rhinos roam with the city skyline as backdrop — truly one of the world's most extraordinary wildlife experiences.

description.zh: 马拉喀什古城（麦地那）是摩洛哥最具活力的历史城区，德吉玛·埃尔芙纳广场是其心脏地带。迷宫般的市集（苏克）中出售各式手工艺品、香料和皮革，色彩绚烂，气息浓郁。
description.en: Marrakech Medina is Morocco's most vibrant historic quarter. Djemaa el-Fna square is its beating heart; the labyrinthine souks sell crafts, spices and leather in a riot of colour and aroma.

location.zh: 马拉喀什省，摩洛哥中南部

description.zh: 梅尔祖卡附近的尔格谢比沙丘是摩洛哥最壮观的沙漠景观，沙丘高达150米。骑骆驼穿越金色沙海、在沙漠帐篷中仰望星空，是无与伦比的非洲体验。
description.en: The Erg Chebbi dunes near Merzouga — up to 150 m high — are Morocco's most spectacular desert scenery. Camel trekking through the golden sea of sand and sleeping under stars in a desert camp are unforgettable.

location.zh: 德拉-塔菲拉莱特大区，摩洛哥东南部

description.zh: 舍夫沙万是摩洛哥北部里夫山中的小城，以几乎所有建筑都涂成靛蓝色和白色而闻名，被誉为「蓝色珍珠」。蜿蜒的蓝色小巷、手工艺品商店和友善的当地居民使其成为摩洛哥最受欢迎的拍照胜地。
description.en: Chefchaouen is Morocco's 'Blue Pearl' — a mountain town in the Rif where nearly every building is painted in shades of indigo and white. Its winding blue lanes and craft shops make it Morocco's most photogenic destination.

location.zh: 舍夫沙万省，摩洛哥北部

description.zh: 大堡礁是世界上最大的珊瑚礁系统，由近3,000个礁石和900余座岛屿组成，绵延超过2,300公里，从太空都清晰可见。这里是全球生物多样性最丰富的海洋生态系统之一，孕育了超过1,500种鱼类。
description.en: The Great Barrier Reef is the world's largest coral system — nearly 3,000 reefs and 900+ islands stretching 2,300 km and visible from space. It supports over 1,500 fish species in one of Earth's most biodiverse marine ecosystems.

location.zh: 昆士兰州近海，澳大利亚东北部

description.zh: 悉尼歌剧院是20世纪最具代表性的建筑之一，由丹麦建筑师约翰·伍重设计，贝壳状的白色屋顶如帆船般矗立于悉尼港。自1973年启用以来，已成为澳大利亚最重要的文化地标。
description.en: The Sydney Opera House is among the 20th century's most iconic buildings, designed by Jorn Utzon. Its shell-like white roof sails over Sydney Harbour. Since its 1973 opening it has been Australia's pre-eminent cultural landmark.

description.zh: 乌鲁鲁是矗立于澳大利亚中部红色沙漠中的巨型砂岩孤峰，高348米，周长约9.4公里。它是澳大利亚原住民阿南古族人的圣地，日出日落时呈现出橙红色到深紫色的神奇色变。
description.en: Uluru is a colossal sandstone monolith rising 348 m from the central Australian desert, 9.4 km in circumference. A sacred site for the Anangu people, it glows from orange-red to deep purple at sunrise and sunset.

description.zh: 惠特森迪群岛由74座岛屿组成，其中白天堂海滩（Whitehaven Beach）以纯白二氧化硅沙粒和清澈绿松石海水被评为澳大利亚最美海滩。这里是帆船航行和大堡礁潜水的理想基地。
description.en: The 74 Whitsunday Islands include Whitehaven Beach — rated Australia's most beautiful beach for its pure silica sand and turquoise water. An ideal base for sailing and Great Barrier Reef diving.

location.zh: 昆士兰州，澳大利亚东北部

description.zh: 蓝山国家公园距悉尼仅约100公里，以三姐妹峰、尤加利树峡谷和壮观的瀑布著称。蓝色雾霭由尤加利树挥发的油脂颗粒形成，赋予山脉独特的蓝色调。
description.en: Just 100 km from Sydney, the Blue Mountains NP is famous for the Three Sisters rock formation, eucalyptus-draped gorges and spectacular waterfalls. The blue haze is caused by oil particles from eucalyptus trees.

location.zh: 新南威尔士州，悉尼以西
location.en: New South Wales, west of Sydney

description.zh: 米尔福德峡湾是新西兰峡湾国家公园的核心景观，被鲁德亚德·吉卜林誉为「世界第八大奇迹」。垂直峭壁从海面直插云端，米特峰高达1,692米，雨后百瀑悬挂，气势磅礴。
description.en: Milford Sound — Rudyard Kipling's 'Eighth Wonder of the World' — is the centrepiece of Fiordland NP. Sheer cliffs plunge from 1,692 m Mitre Peak straight into the sea; after rain, hundreds of waterfalls appear.

description.zh: 霍比特村是彼得·杰克逊《指环王》和《霍比特人》系列电影的拍摄地，位于新西兰北岛的马塔马塔农场。44座圆门霍比特洞穴和「绿龙酒馆」让影迷得以亲历中土世界。
description.en: Hobbiton is the filming location for Peter Jackson's Lord of the Rings and Hobbit trilogies, set on a Matamata farm on New Zealand's North Island. Its 44 hobbit holes and the Green Dragon Inn bring Middle-earth to life.

location.zh: 怀卡托大区马塔马塔，新西兰北岛
location.en: Matamata, Waikato, North Island, New Zealand

description.zh: 皇后镇被誉为「世界探险之都」，是蹦极跳、跳伞、喷射快艇、滑雪等极限运动的发源地或集中地。瓦卡蒂普湖畔依山傍水的小镇风光与壮阔的雪山景观相互映衬，四季皆宜。
description.en: Queenstown is the 'Adventure Capital of the World' — the birthplace of commercial bungee jumping and a hub for skydiving, jet-boating and skiing. Set on Lake Wakatipu beneath snowy peaks, it is superb year-round.

location.zh: 奥塔哥大区，新西兰南岛
location.en: Otago region, South Island, New Zealand

description.zh: 海湾群岛位于新西兰北岛最北端，由144座岛屿组成，是帆船、海豚共游、钓鱼和深潜的天堂。怀唐伊条约签署地——怀唐伊Treaty Grounds也位于此处，是新西兰最重要的历史遗址。
description.en: The Bay of Islands comprises 144 islands at the tip of New Zealand's North Island — paradise for sailing, swimming with dolphins, fishing and diving. Waitangi Treaty Grounds, NZ's most important historic site, stands here.

location.en: Northland region, North Island, New Zealand
